description.value: Category 12 is a small-batch craft brewery and taproom on Keating Cross Road, brewing just 30 kegs at a time using Canadian-made equipment produced less than 1 km from the brewhouse. The taproom includes a bistro serving scratch-made food with local ingredients, plus a viewing window into the brewing operation so visitors can watch while waiting for growler fills. Regular events — live music, wing nights, and trivia — give it a strong community-gathering character.

address.value: Unit C, 2200 Keating Cross Road, Victoria, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms active taproom and bistro operations with upcoming events in May–June 2026, corroborating the OSM phone number and URL.
